title: Case 018: Shipment is approaching its return-to-sender deadline

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: The parcel’s return timer is nearing its cutoff. The carrier permits a new collection arrangement if the verified recipient chooses before that cutoff.
initial_request: No recipient choice is recorded. Please contact authorised recipient Nalo Vere now, before the cutoff, rather than let the return timer expire.
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Contact the recipient to choose a permitted redelivery or collection option before the stated cutoff.

outcome: The carrier confirms the agreed option and cancels the scheduled return.
boundaries: Only carrier confirmation establishes cancellation of the return; collection remains pending.

events.body: DL-018 will enter return-to-sender processing at 16:00 UTC today unless a customer selects redelivery on 2026-02-20 or depot collection on 2026-02-20. Both options are currently available.
No recipient choice is recorded. Please contact authorised recipient Nalo Vere now, before the cutoff, rather than let the return timer expire.
DL-018 is due to return at 16:00 UTC today. Would you like redelivery on 2026-02-20 or depot collection on 2026-02-20? Please select an option so the carrier can stop the return.
Please choose depot collection on 2026-02-20. I can attend during the depot’s collection hours.
We applied your recorded customer choice at 09:55 UTC, before cutoff. Return-to-sender is cancelled; DL-018 is assigned to depot collection on 2026-02-20, 10:00–17:00 UTC. It has not been collected.
